mentions.name: LLM-driven browser agent
mentions.description: A browser agent that relies on LLMs writing Playwright scripts to drive the browser, which the author found works better than having models write vanilla JavaScript.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was working on something almost similar, mostly to create a browser agent, and LLMs are really good at writing playwright scripts compared to vanilla JS.
